title: Exploring Shenzhen's Fairy Lake Botanical Garden
description: Join Rongmao Li on a tour of Fairy Lake Botanical Garden in Shenzhen, where we explore its unique beauty through a tranquil lake, a historic temple, and a banyan tree planted by Deng Xiaoping. Discover the stories and legends that make this garden a must-visit spot in Shenzhen!
